command:
cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
import subprocess
seeds = open('seeds.txt').read().split()
pts = [int(x) for x in open('plaintexts.txt').read().split()]
cts = [int(x) for x in open('ciphertexts.txt').read().split()]
assert len(pts) == len(cts), (len(pts), len(cts))
bad = 0
for i,(p,c) in enumerate(zip(pts,cts),1):
    out = subprocess.run(['./feal', format(p,'x'), *seeds], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    got = int(out.split('Ciphertext:')[1].strip(), 16)
    if got != c:
        bad += 1
        if bad <= 3: print('MISMATCH', i, p, c, got)
print(f'feal-binary check: {len(pts)} plaintexts, {bad} mismatches')
# also verify all 32 known pairs with the shipped binary
pairs = [tuple(map(int,l.split())) for l in open('pairs.txt') if l.strip()]
bad2 = 0
for i,(p,c) in enumerate(pairs,1):
    out = subprocess.run(['./feal', format(p,'x'), *seeds], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    got = int(out.split('Ciphertext:')[1].strip(), 16)
    if got != c:
        bad2 += 1
        if bad2 <= 3: print('PAIR MISMATCH', i, p, c, got)
print(f'feal-binary pairs check: {len(pairs)} pairs, {bad2} mismatches')
print('SEEDS', seeds)
print('FINAL_OK', bad == 0 and bad2 == 0)
EOF
